topic_candidates.title: Elon Musk $20K Humanoid Robot
topic_candidates.query: Tesla Optimus production plans 2026 official filing price target
topic_candidates.brief: The video tests the viral $20,000 Optimus idea against what Tesla has actually disclosed. It explains why a humanoid robot’s price is dominated by actuators, hands, batteries, cameras, compute, safety testing and factory yield—not just raw materials. The key reveal is that mass production is still the hard part: Tesla discusses production lines and a future million-robot capacity, but that is not the same as a $20,000 consumer product being available today.
topic_candidates.evidence_summary: Tesla describes Optimus as a general-purpose humanoid for repetitive or unsafe work and says production-line preparations are underway, with planned capacity eventually reaching one million robots per year. The filing does not establish that a $20,000 robot is currently for sale, so the video should present that figure as a target or claim rather than a confirmed retail price.
